# We are very pleased to announce that AMS Fulfillment has acquired VOX Fulfillment, a third-party logistics provider based in Provo, Utah. This is an important milestone in AMS’s continued growth. · 2026-09-04T00:00:00+00:00

We are very pleased to announce that AMS Fulfillment has acquired VOX Fulfillment, a third-party logistics provider based in Provo, Utah. This is an important milestone in AMS’s continued growth.

VOX operates two facilities totaling approximately 155,000 square feet and has about 125 employees. The company brings an impressive group of customers to AMS, expands our geographic footprint and further strengthens our position in the health, wellness and beauty market. VOX customers will now have access to AMS’s bi-coastal fulfillment network, technology and broader operational resources.

Our team has been working closely with VOX for approximately six months to evaluate the business and plan for a successful transition. We have been impressed by the quality of its operations, customer relationships and employees. Most importantly, we believe there is a strong cultural fit between our organizations. Like AMS, the VOX team cares deeply about its customers, its people and delivering excellent service.

We are very pleased to announce that AMS Fulfillment has acquired VOX Fulfillment, a third-party logistics provider based in Provo, Utah. This is an important milestone in AMS’s continued growth. image

**Reshared from Fort Point Capital:**
> AMS Fulfillment, a portfolio company of Fort Point Capital, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of VOX Fulfillment, a Utah-based third-party omnichannel fulfillment provider serving fast-growing brands across health and wellness, beauty and cosmetics, apparel and consumer products.
